title: Deccy journal entry
description: One recording's inverse: the before and after content of the recorded change's owned paths. A side maps every owned path to the SHA-256 of its content or to null when the path is absent.

id.description: The SHA-256 of the canonical entry (this document without the id field).

kind.description: The operation kind this entry inverts. Only a recording keeps a journal entry.

before.description: The owned paths' content before the recording, keyed by repo-relative path.

after.description: The owned paths' content after the recording, keyed by repo-relative path.
